verdict.rationale: Vonage's own docs describe server-side SDKs, programmatic session creation with configurable media and archive modes, server-generated JWT tokens, and registrable session-monitoring callbacks, plus a published llms.txt. That shows a documented programmatic surface. However, no evidence explicitly shows a public REST API reference or endpoint specification, and nothing independent confirms programmatic use, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: an explicit public REST API reference or endpoint documentation, evidence of API coverage across product features (e.g., archive control via API), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The platform includes client libraries for the web, mobile and desktop platform as well as server-side SDKs.
Server-generated Vonage Application JWT tokens grant client SDK access.
When you create a session, you specify how clients in the session will send audio-video streams, known as the media mode.
Server endpoints can also register to receive HTTP requests triggered by stream activity on all sessions for a given project.
Vonage Communication APIs enable developers to embed messaging, voice, video
